newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec brass mill output rises 3.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec brass mill output rises 3.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's brass mill output in December rose for the third consecutive month, gaining 3.0 percent from the same month a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted 103,610 tonnes, according to preliminary data released on Thursday by the Japan Brass Makers' Association.
Apart from preliminary data for December output, the association released the following final data for November (in tonnes):
*(Note: November output figure revised, seasonally adjusted.)

November shipments to the semiconductor sector, while hitting their highest level since March, were still far below year-ago levels. Demand showed strong year-on-year gains in the remainder of the electronics sector, however.
Shipments were fractionally lower to the automotive sector and up slightly to the air-conditioning/refrigeration sector.
